interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to configure and manage (e.g., primary LAN, WAN, bridge).

wan_if.description: Interface connected to the external/upstream network (WAN).

lan_if.description: Interface used for the primary internal (LAN) network.

bridge_if.description: Optional bridge interface for guest or DMZ networks.

lan_ip.description: IPv4 address of the router on the LAN, in CIDR notation.

secondary_lan_subnets.description: Additional IPv4 subnets (CIDR) served on separate VLANs or interfaces.

dhcp_start.description: First IP address in the DHCP lease pool for the LAN.

dhcp_end.description: Last IP address in the DHCP lease pool for the LAN.

dhcp_dns_servers.description: List of DNS servers to advertise via DHCP (typically includes router and upstream).

ntp_server.description: NTP server used by the router and advertised to clients.

router_hostname.description: Hostname assigned to the router (used in DHCP hostname option and local DNS).

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 addressing and routing on the LAN.

ipv6_ula_prefix.description: IPv6 Unique Local Address (ULA) prefix for internal use (non-routable).

allow_ssh_lan.description: Allow SSH access from LAN clients.

allow_icmp_lan.description: Allow ICMP echo requests (ping) from LAN.

icmp_rate_limit.description: Maximum ICMP packets per second allowed from a single source (0 = unlimited).

web_proxy_enabled.description: Enable the local web proxy (Squid) for caching and filtering.

web_proxy_port.description: TCP port on which the web proxy listens.

content_filter_enabled.description: Enable content filtering (via SquidGuard or similar).

content_filter_log_dir.description: Directory to store content filter logs.

bandwidth_up_kbit.description: Upload bandwidth limit (in kbit/s) for shaping rules.

bandwidth_shape_classes.description: Space-separated class definitions for bandwidth classes (format: classid:bandwidth_kbit).

rsyslog_remote_server.description: Remote rsyslog server for centralized logging (e.g., logserver.example.com:514).

fail2ban_enabled.description: Enable the fail2ban intrusion prevention daemon.

fail2ban_max_retry.description: Number of failed attempts before banning an IP.

fail2ban_find_time.description: Window (in seconds) in which to count failures.

ldap_enabled.description: Enable LDAP integration (for user/group auth in captive portal, proxy, or ACLs).

ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for authenticating to LDAP (optional; leave blank for anonymous bind).

ldap_bind_pwd.description: Password for the LDAP bind user.

captive_portal_enabled.description: Enable a captive portal (e.g., for guest access).

captive_portal_if.description: Interface on which the captive portal is enforced.

captive_portal_redirect_url.description: URL to redirect users to for authentication.

guest_vlan.description: VLAN ID for guest network (0 = disabled).

guest_isolated.description: Block inter-client communication on guest VLAN.

mac_whitelist_enabled.description: Only allow clients with MAC addresses listed in the whitelist file.

mac_whitelist_file.description: Path to file containing allowed MAC addresses (one per line).

snmp_community.description: SNMP read community (not recommended for production use without TLS/ACLs).

snmp_location.description: Physical location of the router for SNMP discovery.

wol_relay_enabled.description: Enable Wake-on-LAN relay to forward WoL packets from WAN to LAN.

wol_relay_multicast_group.description: Multicast group (or broadcast) to which WoL packets are relayed.
